summary: The customer called to complain about an unexpectedly high bill and confusion regarding a contract renewal. The agent explained that the contract renewed automatically. After the customer expressed dissatisfaction, the agent agreed to log a complaint and cancel the renewal.

evidence.text: أنا راح أسجلك complaint وألغي التجديد
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Log a complaint and cancel the contract renewal.

evidence.text: مرحبا معك شركة الاتصالات، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite and professional tone throughout the interaction.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، أنا راح أسجلك complaint وألغي التجديد
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration and offered to resolve the issue directly.

evidence.text: أنا راح أسجلك complaint وألغي التجديد
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent effectively offered a clear path to resolution by logging a complaint and cancelling the renewal.

evidence.text: حضرتك عملت contract renewal الشهر الماضي، فالـ promotion القديمة خلصت وصار ينحسب عليك السعر الجديد.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The explanation of the automatic renewal was provided, though it initially confused the customer.

evidence.text: تمام، يا ريت والله، شكراً كتير لك ومتاعبك.
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The call ended amicably and acknowledged the customer's appreciation, though a formal closing statement was missing.

evidence.text: النظام عندنا بيعمل automatic renewal إذا ما صار cancellation قبل شهر من النهاية.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent provided accurate information regarding the system's automatic renewal policy.

evidence.text: بس ممكن تعطيني رقم الموبايل لو سمحت؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly asked for the customer's mobile number to verify the account details before proceeding.

quote.text: عندي مشكلة بالفاتورة الأخيرة، I got a bill that is much higher than usual وما عم بفهم ليش?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: بس شو قصدك بالفاتورة؟ Didn't I renew on the old price?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Wait, sorry, شو يعني renewal? أنا ما طلبت أجدد العقد أصلاً!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Sorry, can you say that again? يعني غصب عني تجدد العقد؟ أنا مش فاهمة شي صراحة.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: تمام، يا ريت والله، شكراً كتير لك ومتاعبك.
quote.speaker: Customer
